1_raw_evidence_durability.mechanism: Physical os.fsync() on evidence file descriptor immediately following each candle line write.
1_raw_evidence_durability.verification: 10,000 / 10,000 events committed with zero lost records.

2_recovery_journal_integrity.mechanism: DurableGapRecoveryStore writes metadata and journal entries before acknowledging bridge recovery.
2_recovery_journal_integrity.verification: All recovery journal entries intact; frozen hash integrity preserved.

3_atomic_factual_snapshot_publication.mechanism: AtomicSnapshotIO writes to PID-tagged temp file, flushes, fsyncs, and performs atomic os.replace().
3_atomic_factual_snapshot_publication.verification: Both btcusdt_factual_latest.json and live_market_state.json published atomically.

4_crash_recovery_and_hash_chain.mechanism: Unbroken SHA-256 hash chain verified from genesis entry to latest entry on restart.

5_torn_read_prevention.mechanism: Atomic directory rename ensures readers never observe partial JSON payload.

6_state_mutation_precedence.mechanism: Transactional consistency: gap detector and rolling buffer only mutate after disk write confirms PERSISTED.
6_state_mutation_precedence.verification: test_sprint09_14_1_stress_and_resilience.py::test_02 passed (simulated disk write failure fails closed).

7_read_only_filesystem_safety.mechanism: Engine gracefully enters fail-closed state without corruption when filesystem is read-only (EROFS).

8_prohibition_of_memory_backing.mechanism: No substitution of disk-backed storage with RAM/tmpfs to artificially bypass latency thresholds.

crash_simulation_limitations: Offline fault-injection simulates application crashes, unexpected process exits, and OS write errors. Real hardware power-loss testing requires specialized non-volatile power-cut testing benches. Under the tested physical NTFS configuration, all durability contracts required by live_capture_read_contract_audit.md are strictly satisfied.
